carries: r4-P10 (residual: size-and-power table of the register's fixed procedures)
title: Calibration battery for interval methods
label: Exploratory; not a test of H1-H10.
agnosticism: No measure in this study can tell whether a non-human source speaks; every measure describes the speech in these recordings and how the creators present it.
written_by: a step-1 agent (a model agent working for the project lead; not a person)
base: label-free analogues from CAL's seen-only cache; nine design classes, pools of between 60 and 71 of the 71 seen creators
reading: not applicable: a method card's run (register kind 'act'); it picks interval methods and reads no contrast
key_results: t interval on recordings ignoring creators covers 39% to 71% in every class and count
TL-7.1-type slope pooling (DerSimonian-Laird, its bootstrap, HKSJ) covers 0.5% to 57%; t on slopes 0.73 (5) to 0.89 (71); no method holds below 71
t on creator means holds for E at every count; H and B1 at 8+; G at 12+; C at 30+; not for A at any count (HKSJ instead at most counts)
D (probability of superiority): no method holds below 71 creators
floor-rule pass at half the margin: 0.0005 to 0.109 per primary (the disclosure's 2.8 of 56 is approximate; up to about 6.1 in the worst cell)

code_sha256.code/prespec.json: the hash recorded at hashing time is kept privately

departures: classes, methods, counts, draws, holds and choice rules fixed by the agent in code/prespec.json before the run (the method card left them open)
label-free analogues only; CAL-f parts (b), (c) and the registered tests not re-run
not run: circular/local-block/unit-shuffle references, curveball, rewired-dyad permutation, Freedman-Lane, pooled-ratio estimands
class F margin not deposited: 0.20 between-creator SD of slopes (flagged)
for_the_lead: the choice rule flips between neighbouring methods within Monte Carlo error of the tolerance (A, B); whether to fix one method per class is the lead's decision
random-effects choices can move the estimand away from the creator mean in real data (seen in r3-P02's primary I)
cells where no method holds (D below 71, F below 71, A at 23 and 71, B at 30, C at 5 to 12): readings at most undetermined
the half-effect disclosure's 2.8 understates chance passes for classes B to E
